method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading of every heading plus a rule-by-rule reverse reading of the unchanged proof trees, followed by exact formula, macro and identifier comparison; not independent or human review.
scope: The LK propositional-rule section: the general heading and the left/right rules for negation, conjunction, disjunction and the material conditional.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The section is titled Propositional Rules.
samples.checks: विधानीय follows the established propositional-logic register, and the section macro is unchanged.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The negation rules move A from the right of Gamma sequent Delta to negated A on the left, and move A from the left to negated A on the right.
samples.checks: Only the subsection heading is translated. Both unary trees, premise/conclusion order, LeftR/RightR labels, contexts and negation placement remain byte-identical to the source.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: There are two unary conjunction-left alternatives, deriving A-and-B on the left from either A or B there, and one binary conjunction-right rule requiring both right-side premises before deriving A-and-B on the right.
samples.checks: Only the subsection heading is translated. The two left variants, the shared-context binary right rule, all A/B positions, proof arities and layout macros remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Disjunction-left is binary and requires both A-left and B-left premises; the two unary disjunction-right alternatives derive A-or-B on the right from either A or B there.
samples.checks: Only the subsection heading is translated. The left/right dual arrangement, both proof arities, contexts, formulas and labels remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Conditional-left combines Gamma sequent Delta,A with B,Pi sequent Lambda to derive A-implies-B,Gamma,Pi sequent Delta,Lambda. Conditional-right derives Gamma sequent Delta,A-implies-B from A,Gamma sequent Delta,B.
samples.checks: Only the subsection heading is translated. The binary and unary arities, four contexts, their concatenation order, formula sides and LeftR/RightR labels remain exact.

limitations: No independent linguistic review has been performed.
The proof trees contain no ordinary prose; their formal content is intentionally unchanged, so semantic review depends on rule-by-rule reverse reading plus exact structural comparison.
विधानीय is directly supported in Marathi university logic usage; the concise साठीचे नियम heading construction is ordinary compositional Marathi rather than a separately attested specialist label.
